column1: #  - only forms at the top level of the file count; a fn, local or var inside a function, let, when or each is a local;
#  - fn, lambda and λ with a name are functions, and so is macro (macros are functions); a dotted name (fn M.method) is named by its last part, as in Lua;
#  - (local f (fn ..)), the same with var, global, lambda and λ, is a function; (set M.f (fn ..)) is a function named f;
#  - any other (local x v), (var x v) or (global x v) binding one plain name is a variable; (set M.x 3) is not a definition;
#  - destructuring bindings, the (macros {..}) table, import-macros, require and calls are not definitions.
